fabricated_details: Production impact details for Hydraulic Press A
Compressor operational status details and monitoring steps
Welding robot cell number and test weld actions
Specific follow-up tasks and maintenance workflows
rationale: The report captures all reported items completely and formats them clearly, but heavily fabricates timestamps, ticket numbers, production impacts, and extensive follow-up actions not present in the input. The time for the lockout was also misreported from 2:10 to 14:10. Uncertainty handling is poor as it presents unsupported statuses and actions as if they were established facts.
